lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Plate to right flange; the flange turns about 88 deg (a real formed fold, well over 10 deg). In perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the line lies on the outer-skin arc apex: 0.01/0.04/0.12 mm from the surface and 0.11/0.04/0.23 mm from the outer apex (the surface point nearest the sharp corner). The line is parallel to the fold. Its 97.9 mm length covers about 97.5% of the roughly 100.4 mm visible fold, which runs the full part length with no reliefs.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Plate to left flange, about 88 deg, mirror of B1. Sections at 25/50/75% put it 0.07/0.08/0.05 mm from the surface and 0.21/0.08/0.05 mm from the outer apex. It is parallel to the fold, and its 97.8 mm length covers about 97.4% of the roughly 100.4 mm fold.
